tasks.short: Train others to observe and check geodetic and plane coordinate controls.

steps.what: Find current control procedures, coordinate conventions and actual training examples
Prepare and check actual demonstrations and coordinate-control exercises for the learners
Demonstrate observation and control checks and interpret methods with actual learners
Enter and check actual training observations in the existing learning record
Save the checked actual training observation entry

tasks.design: Configure a native {DOCS} method-source index and reusable exercise layouts. Keep actual coordinate interpretation, demonstrations, practice feedback and required {LMS} observation entry human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source finding and exercise layout.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked sources and worksheet templates.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing why a learner misinterprets a coordinate control.
tasks.human_edge: Demonstrate sound field technique and explain observed mistakes.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated preparation layout; training responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked method sources and worksheet templates reduce repeated preparation without replacing geodetic interpretation or practice feedback.

assumptions: Boundary covers actual training preparation, delivery and required observation entry. Procedure owners supply revision, coordinate reference and control instructions; surveyor verifies examples in s1 and produces exercise values in s2. Missing fields require manual preparation. Actual performance is not recorded before s4.

Native first. Provisional shares, not measured; repeated materials only when actually produced, informal interpretation has no invented worksheet baseline. Existing layouts earn zero. Ordinary material and entry checks are included; saves1 each fully retained.
research_questions: Which repeated exercises can reuse a native layout safely?

incremental.description: Maintain method source links and exercise layouts

approvals.approved_version: s2 checked training materials with actual coordinate conventions
s5 checked actual training observation entry

tasks.short: Prepare geodetic progress and technical reports.

steps.what: Locate actual survey progress, observation logs, adjustment results and reporting requirements
Determine actual progress, geodetic findings, unresolved controls and reportable limitations
Populate actual coordinate tables, adjustment statistics and progress figures in the report template
Write the actual progress or technical explanation and its limitations

loop.purpose: Draft explanatory report prose from actual findings
loop.input: Selected actual findings and checked evidence pack
loop.output: Draft progress or technical explanation with source references
loop.check: Surveyor verifies coordinate and datum meaning, actual completion state, uncertainty and unresolved controls; rejects invented results, omitted limitations or false acceptance claims.
loop.stop: Missing support or two failed revisions returns prose to manual writing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Native report tables handle fixed data first; variable explanation of actual findings needs prose composition.

steps.what: Check the complete final report against actual source versions, conclusions and project destination
Save the checked final geodetic report in the project record

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} survey report exports and {DOCS} templates before custom assembly. A bounded drafting loop explains selected actual findings; the surveyor retains scientific conclusions and final report checks before save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated table assembly and explanation drafting.
tasks.enabler_now: Native adjustment reports, project views and bounded drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining datum choices, uncertainty and unresolved observations.
tasks.human_edge: Decide what technical conclusions the evidence supports.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive reporting; technical accountability unchanged.

evidence.claim: Trimble Business Center provides least-squares adjustment and adjustment reports; this supports native technical output, not automatic project conclusions.
Model knowledge: bounded drafting can express selected actual findings with human semantic verification.

assumptions: Boundary is report preparation through final project save, not a separate dissemination task. Field and project producers supply observation IDs, dates, coordinate frame, adjustment version, residuals, actual progress and unresolved issues; surveyor verifies in s1 and selects conclusions in s2. Missing source fields require manual assembly.

Native first. Provisional20 table share is actual human assembly, not existing report computation; already generated native tables earn zero. Shares not measured. Draft review s4 and final QA s5 are counted existing report work, no added approval ritual. Save1 fully retained.
unknowns: Current native report use and prose effort
research_questions: Can report drafts preserve uncertainty and distinguish planned from completed work?

incremental.description: Maintain report mappings and sample-check narrative output

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked complete final geodetic report and project destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional source10 at50 saves5, table20 removed saves20, narrative24 at50 saves12; gross37 minus2 upkeep=35. Half eligible finding, assembly and prose gives16.5. Findings25 and final QA20 unchanged.

tasks.short: Review survey standards, controls and equipment and recommend improvements.

steps.what: Find and read current standards, control histories and actual equipment specifications
Inspect actual control performance, equipment condition and observed procedural problems
Judge adequacy and choose defensible changes or equipment upgrades
Write and check the recommendation evidence, limitations and proposed changes
outputs: checked recommendation record and recipient copy

inputs: checked recommendation record and recipient copy

steps.what: Send the checked recommendation copy to the internal method or equipment owner
inputs: checked recommendation record and recipient copy

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} revision links and a review recommendation template. Preserve actual equipment inspection, adequacy judgement and choice of upgrades; only source finding and repeated written layout change.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source hunting and review document layout.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding whether a control weakness warrants procedural or equipment change.
tasks.human_edge: Weigh actual survey performance against intended use.
tasks.altitude: Less review preparation layout; upgrade decisions unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native standards links and review templates reduce repeated finding and layout without assessing actual equipment adequacy.

assumptions: Boundary is review and recommendation, not procurement or implementation. Standards and equipment owners supply revisions, control histories and specifications; surveyor checks sources in s1, captures actual observations in s2 and records chosen changes in s4. Missing or conflicting data require manual checking.

Native first. Provisional shares not measured. Existing index or template earns zero. Ordinary recommendation checking includes audience and source limitations; no extra approval meeting. Save and send1 each fully retained. No upgrade order is placed.
unknowns: Actual review document requirements and current templates
research_questions: Which source navigation and layout work remains after native configuration?

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked recommendation copy and internal owner destination
